## PR-012+013 continuation: immutable local original ledger

The merged #47 supplied complete paged repository history and opt-in Desktop scan controls. This continuation adds an additive Source/Version/Observation ledger for explicitly selected local FILE and MEDIA originals in the same Content Lab SQLite database.

- Raw bytes are staged in 64 KiB parts keyed by namespace and exact SHA-256. Two origins with identical bytes share one object; a changed origin creates a new version. Observations have independent intent keys.

- The Windows installer includes the new module. A standalone isolated-Python CLI provides capture without browser grants or implicit network access.
- Nine local tests pass: identity/reuse, stable key across path rename, 23-version continuation, interrupted stage, drift/corruption, additive migration, pair-bound byte delta continuation across 51 parts, and installed-style CLI. Windows exposed a false SOURCE_DRIFT after file rewrites; head `1d0ead5e3091582bd32f6afe1745e4c73430757a` changes the Windows check to exact two-pass bytes plus file identity. Exact-head CI is pending; installed Windows device qualification is pending.

Design and limits: `docs/automation/pr012-013-source-ledger.md`. This is a substrate, **not completion of the combined 101 criteria**. Existing ChatGPT import uses its own specialized raw table; unified CAS reconciliation, parser/extraction cache, selective evidence invalidation, PDF/Office/OCR, media/ASR, web/RSS/GitHub adapters, Core background jobs and full scale/device receipts remain open. Keep this PR draft until its scoped stage is validated; do not present #47 or this continuation as the full roadmap.

PR-016 and PR-017 need one shared implementation path: edited text or a final voice transcript must enter the existing Core queue, and an uncertain external Send must survive cancellation/restart without another click.

Enqueue uses existing jobs/leases and the single global writer. Revision/policy/STOP fences reject stale execution. Send requires an explicit SEND mode, target grants and pinned selected-UI qualification; frozen prompts retain goal, criteria and exact part hashes. Lost acknowledgement remains NEEDS_RECONCILIATION, with no blind resend.

## Included

- Typed Native/desktop/CLI dispatcher; unknown capabilities remain development proposals.
- Topologically ordered fixed-effect DAGs, closed payloads, text/voice semantic parity, original transcript provenance and correction cancellation.
- Streaming WAV PTT with one OS capture lease, optional Windows hotkey/local CPU ASR, editable preview and a separate STOP connection.
- Immutable multipart ledger with no total part-count cap; current eligible namespace sources and durable per-part observations.
- Optional operator-configured local CDP text composer route, exact account/workspace/conversation binding, focus/draft checks and browser/code/contract receipt admission.
- Correlated manual result import; UI observations and model received/used claims remain distinct.
- Successful Core trace → skill candidate, pinned dependency/code receipts, fixture/device distinction, scope fencing, stale invalidation, retained failures and a conservative optimizer that creates another unqualified candidate.
- Russian launch/qualification/rollback instructions, all 50 function mappings and all 220 original criterion rows with exact wording preserved.

## Validation

On the current main integration base (including PR-006/007):
- Content Lab: **353 passed**, real Git/SQLite and the existing 125000-file inventory fixture.
- Desktop: **30 tests, passed, 2 skipped** because a local Tk display is unavailable; includes real Native IPC and synthetic PCM lifecycle tests.
- Native bridge: **47 passed**; extension: **116 passed**; qualification adapter: **8 passed**.
- Desktop owned-file hashes and git diff whitespace checks pass.

Remote tree bytes were verified against the local implementation tree before publishing. Existing CI runs full regressions on Ubuntu/Windows and Linux Tk through Xvfb.

## Why draft / remaining scope

All **220 source criteria remain OPEN** until criterion-level evidence and required device/UI receipts. This is a combined implementation baseline, not a claim that the whole strategy is finished.

Not yet qualified/implemented: actual Windows microphone/ASR/hotkey latency corpus, installed Laya vendor interface, actual selected Grok account/UI, binary uploads/provider limits, complete remote history or automatic streaming-finalization import, parameterized portable skills, mixed-effect end-to-end DAGs and full planner/retriever/critic orchestration. pull_requests.title: PR001: stream whole repositories with durable scan controls
pull_requests.body:
Repositories with more than one page currently require repeated scan clicks, and Git output above 32 MiB or blobs above 8 MiB are rejected. This change makes “Собрать весь repo” pump every page automatically and replaces both size caps with streaming Git inventory/blob capture.

The existing SQLite owner now persists START/STATUS/STEP/PAUSE/CONTINUE/CANCEL runs with atomic cursor/revision guards, idempotent intents and page replay, cancelled-intent tombstones, source/profile checks and crash recovery. The UI keeps Pause/Stop available during a page, rejects stale replies and restores STATUS without automatically resuming. Transactional ledger counters and ordinal pagination avoid rescanning the inventory for every page. Trusted native progress extends idle watchdogs while individual native messages remain bounded.

20 entries is a page size, not a repository file limit. UTF-8/binary bytes are captured in exact fragments; large files disclose text-only parsing outside the 2 MiB AST window. Protected names, metadata exclusions and read failures remain explicit gaps. Legacy scan/get/export and database/review records remain compatible.

Includes the supplied 45-file corpus at cursors 20/40/45; full 2005-file processing; a 125000-entry inventory emitting 38500000 bytes; UTF-8/binary blobs above 8 MiB; an actual process exit before commit; and UI → installed native adapter → Git/SQLite restart with simulated reply loss after a real commit. The large-tree case qualifies inventory and cancels before processing all its blobs.

companion_studious.title: ROADMAP PR-020 + PR-021: pinned offline research owner
companion_studious.body:
A reviewed SCE request can now execute finite research work in the pinned Studious owner and return an immutable trial receipt. This implements the offline model slice of the combined ROADMAP PR-020 + PR-021.

- Adds a strict `-I` command with clean exact-source and dataset/config digest checks, exclusive run claim, verified completed replay and reconciliation for interrupted runs.
- Reuses MDE point-in-time revision selection, lender repayment/debt arithmetic, PR148 costs and the existing finite clearing solver. Dedup uses temporary on-disk storage and includes instrument generation.
- Executes supplied circular/triangular, liquidation+swap, peg/wrapper, intent-clearing and delayed cross-chain/basis/funding models. Independent clearing checks verify limits, access, times and conservation.
- Records parseable negative/failed outcomes; failed handlers do not establish useful work. Unknown costs, future/stale state, debt shortfall, cross-domain atomic routes and delayed flashloan repayment remain blocked.
- Keeps all artifacts explicitly OFFLINE_FIXTURE, with no execution/release right and zero transactions.

Validation: 182 selected domain tests and 28 release tests passed locally. Static/format/type/security, five source-hygiene roots and six release checks passed. The actual SCE Core → Studious → installed Native siblings → Desktop client path executed five packs twice, preserving identical trials: 470 records, 460 handler calls and 450 useful domain evaluations.

Companion SCE PR: https://github.com/BobIvans/scaling-chrome-extensions/pull/52. Source contracts and limitations: `docs/roadmap/occ-pr020-021-research.md`.

This draft does not close the whole strategy. Real provider/PAPER acquisition, protocol instruction/runtime evidence, holdout and latency/size studies, installed Dell, usefulness ablations/ROI, dependent PR-010..019 integration and semantic acceptance remain open. Positive model results do not establish real market profitability.
